name: SKS Dark
use: The dark-field template. Midnight navy field, amber accent, dense read-not-projected pages, for screen-first material shown next to dark UI or video. Geometry measured from sks-dark.pptx; palette sampled from the reference comps.

geometry.radius_note: deck-build takes one radius; the template's own panels run 2.0-26.0pt by role. See references/grid.md.

discipline: Built on 60-30-10 by area, inverted onto a dark field. 60% field: #1A293A midnight page with #213040 panel, #273546 callout and #3E4C5A rules, all within 1.2:1 of each other so the tints read as one family — raising a tint too far on a dark ground reads as a lit panel, not a grouping. 30% supporting: #F4F1EF headline ink at 13.13:1, #A9B2BB muted ink at 6.87:1, and #CCA348 gold where the accent is type. 10% accent: #B57319 amber as area — title rules, spines, badges, chart series 1 — plus #8A5613 as the field for bands and dividers. The accent runs in three value steps of one hue because no single warm can be a quiet rule, a small label and a full-bleed field at once: #B57319 is area-only at 3.82:1, #CCA348 carries type at 6.26:1 and takes dark ink at 6.26:1 as a fill, #8A5613 carries #F4F1EF at 5.46:1. Cover, Section Divider and Closing are full-bleed #8A5613 by design and exempt. No shadows, no glows, no coloured field beyond those three layouts. Dense and read-not-projected: type is small for its canvas and hierarchy is carried by weight and colour, not size. Light type on a dark ground blooms — never add bold to compensate.
never: amber #B57319 as text below 24px (3.82:1 on the field — area only)
steel #698EB1 as body text (4.29:1 — display sizes only)
the reference grey #727C86 as supporting copy (3.48:1 on the field, 2.94:1 on the callout tint — use #A9B2BB at 5.80)
light text on a #B57319 fill (3.44:1) — drop the fill to #8A5613 or raise it to #CCA348 with #1A293A ink
#CCA348 or #B57319 as text in the .docx / .xlsx mapping — 2.36:1 and 3.87:1 on white
more than one accent as area per page; four amber blocks is decoration, not an accent
coloured slide fields outside Cover / Section Divider / Closing
bold body copy to compensate for the dark ground
中文 without font.ea set to 微軟正黑體
mixing this identity with ANA Blue, Yukima or Reiser Warm in one file

proportions.note: #CCA348 appears in both bands: as type it is supporting, as area it is accent. #B57319 is accent only — it can never be type below 24px.

derived.#A9B2BB: lightened from the comp's #727C86, which is 3.48:1 on the field and fails as supporting copy
derived.#8A5613: darkened from #B57319 so a full-bleed accent field carries #F4F1EF at 5.46:1
derived.#8FA9C4: lightened from the comp's #698EB1 so the steel hue can carry small labels at 6.08:1
